how to train your brain to
focus for hours

one tab only

work with a single tab and a single window open. every extra screen is a small invitation to leave, and your brain accepts far more of those invitations than you think.

the warm up

start every focus session with five easy minutes on the task, like rereading notes or tidying the page. your brain warms up like a muscle, and the hard part comes easier.

short daily lessons

spend 5 minutes a day learning one thing from start to finish with no distractions. finishing small things trains the same attention you need for long, deep work.
slides.texte_sophia:
short daily lessons

i spend 5 minutes a day finishing one lesson from start to finish, no distractions. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and it trained the attention i use for deep work.

slides.texte_overlay:
the phone in another room

put your phone in another room, not just face down on the desk. a phone within reach pulls at your attention even when it stays silent, and out of sight really is out of mind.

planned breaks

work for 45 minutes, then take a real 10 minute break away from screens. focus isn't about never stopping, it's about stopping on purpose before your mind drifts away.
